paper.title_en: New Face of Standard Model: Neutral Magnetic Monopole
paper.abstract_en: We show that the standard model has a totally new type of monopole which has the neutral magnetic charge $4π/\be$, where $\be$ is the neutral charge. This tells that the standard model has two types of monopoles, the well known Cho-Maison type which has the magnetic charge $4π/e$ and the neutral type which has the neutral magnetic charge $4π/\be$. This necessitates the new neutral charge quantization rule $\be=4πn/\bar g$, in addition to the Dirac's electric charge quantization rule $e=4πn/g$. The mass of the new monopole could be less than the Cho-Maison monopole, around 3.28 TeV. We show how to construct the neutral monopole and clarify the topological origin of the new monopole. We discuss the implications of the new monopoles in physics.
